title: Set Theory
description: Everything is a set. Power sets, the continuum, and the axiom of choice.

puzzle.goal: A set S has n elements. Count its subsets by size with binomial coefficients and add them up. Then the collection of all those subsets is itself a set: count ITS subsets the same way, with the inner count used as the size.
puzzle.name: Cardinality of the iterated power set (binomial sums)
puzzle.form: sum ( j , 0 , sum ( k , 0 , n , binom ( n , k ) ) , binom ( sum ( k , 0 , n , binom ( n , k ) ) , j ) )
puzzle.ask: Each binomial sum collapses to a power of two, giving 2^(2ⁿ). Find the size of the power set of the power set of a 4-element set.

vars.N: number of subsets of the set of subsets
vars.k: size of a subset of S
vars.j: size of a set of subsets

puzzle.method: Σₖ C(n,k) counts all subsets; the outer sum does the same for a set whose size is that inner sum.
